_purpose: Declared context budget per LLM lane. A lane with no row here is a lane nobody sized, which is a review-blocking gap — see tests/context-budget-manifest-test.sh. Numbers are INPUT TOKENS PER CALL as recorded in cost.csv, so they are comparable to runner_input_stats_7d in summary.json without conversion.
_units: DECLARED CEILINGS are policy numbers in per-call CONTEXT TOKENS (input_toks + cache_read — the only unit comparable across runners, because for claude the context lives in cache_read and input_toks reads ~57). A BOUND AND THE THING IT PROTECTS AGAINST MUST BE IN THE SAME UNIT, or the guard is a coincidence: runner_ceilings.grok is stated in this same cumulative unit while xAI's cliff is per-request — see any lane's runner_ceilings_note. Where they differ, the manifest says so rather than letting the reader assume they match. context_kill_tokens (BH-653) is the one number here the harness ENFORCES rather than declares: same unit, cumulative over the session, and bin/agent-call.sh kills the CLI when a metered lane crosses it. A lane without the key is unbounded exactly as every lane was before it existed.
_measured: measured_before is NOT uniform and must not be read as if it were. Where present it is stated per lane. Where null, see measured_before_note — the figure was withdrawn rather than left standing in the wrong unit.
